summary:
The 5-Day Greece Tour – Athens City Package keeps Athens as your base while adding two contrasting day trips beyond the capital. Explore the Acropolis and Athens’ historic center, travel into central Greece for the archaeological site of Delphi, then spend a day on the Saronic Gulf visiting Hydra, Poros and Aegina by cruise. This structure lets you experience ancient history and island life without changing hotels during the trip.
Offered from April to October, the package includes selected 4-star accommodation with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, private airport transfers, a full-day Saronic Islands cruise with lunch, and the scheduled sightseeing in the program.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Athens
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Athens International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Half day Morning Athens City tour
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a half-day guided tour of Athens, including the Acropolis of Athens, Acropolis Museum, and Parthenon. Continue past the Parliament, Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, Presidential Palace, Panathenaic Stadium, Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Arch of Hadrian. Afternoon at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Full day Delphi Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Drive through Boeotia, passing Thebes, Levadia, and Arachova en route to Delphi, the famous ancient sanctuary once known as the center of the ancient world. Visit the Sanctuary and Temple of Apollo at Delphi, Treasury of the Athenians, and the Delphi Archaeological Museum, home to the famous bronze Charioteer and Aghias statues. Return to Athens in the evening. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Full day Saronic Island Cruise
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel, then transfer to Port of Piraeus for your cruise to the Saronic Islands. Visit Hydra, Poros, and Aegina with free time to explore, shop, swim, or relax by the sea. Lunch will be served on board during the cruise. Return to Athens in the evening. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Departure from Athens
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Athens Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 5-Day Athens City Break Tour?
faqs.a: The 5-Day Athens City Break Tour covers Athens, Delphi, and the beautiful Saronic Islands. You will discover Athens' ancient landmarks, visit the legendary archaeological site of Delphi, and enjoy a scenic excursion to the charming Saronic Islands. The tour runs for 4 nights and 5 days and offers a perfect combination of history, culture, and coastal beauty.

faqs.q: How much does the 5-Day Athens City Break Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,095 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees according to the itinerary, selected meals, transportation during tours, and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel availability.

faqs.q: What are the main attractions included in Athens?
faqs.a: Athens highlights typically include the Acropolis, Parthenon, Temple of Olympian Zeus, Panathenaic Stadium, Syntagma Square, and the charming Plaka district. These landmarks provide a fascinating introduction to the history and culture of ancient and modern Greece.

faqs.q: What can I expect during the Delphi tour?
faqs.a: The Delphi excursion takes you to one of Greece's most important archaeological sites. You will visit the Sanctuary of Apollo, the ancient theater, the stadium, and the archaeological museum while learning about Delphi's role as the spiritual and religious center of the ancient Greek world.

faqs.q: Does the 5-day Athens City Break Tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during all scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guide will provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise to enhance your experience throughout the trip.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors. It combines Athens' most famous historical landmarks with the archaeological treasures of Delphi and the relaxing atmosphere of the Saronic Islands, providing an excellent introduction to Greece.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic neighborhoods, and island promenades. Delphi involves some walking on uneven surfaces, but most travelers in average health can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of the Saronic Islands excursion?
faqs.a: The Saronic Islands are known for their picturesque harbors, traditional architecture, beautiful coastal scenery, and relaxed atmosphere. Depending on the itinerary, you may visit islands such as Hydra, Poros, and Aegina, each offering unique cultural and scenic experiences.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Athens City Break Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 5-Day Athens City Break Tour available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year and can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights in Athens, upgrade hotel categories, include additional excursions, or modify the itinerary. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
